Say hello in another language. Go on.
Now imagine all eight billion of us spoke just one language.
Guess first: how many languages exist today? Comment a number.

text: Over seven thousand! About seven thousand one hundred sixty four.

One language means no subtitles, and you could chat with anyone on Earth.
But about forty percent are already endangered, many with under a thousand speakers.

text: Each one has its own songs, jokes and stories. They would go silent.

People tried this in eighteen eighty seven, with a made up language: Esperanto.

text: Today, up to two million people speak it. Out of eight billion.
One language for the whole world: yes or no?
